lanes.title: Horizon: reconstruct discrepancy, threshold, action, disclosure, and redress
lanes.question: How did one Horizon discrepancy become debt, suspension, prosecution, conviction, appeal, quashing, and compensation, and where could it have been stopped?
lanes.falsifier: Representative cases show timely independent verification, equal evidence access, and effective pre-action review prevented erroneous consequence.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close with at least one complete vertical chain and a denominator of non-action, correction, prosecution, and reversal outcomes.

lanes.title: Loomis: measure proprietary score contribution, warning, and judicial override
lanes.question: What did the exact COMPAS version contribute to sentence, what could the defense inspect, and did judicial cautions create meaningful veto?
lanes.falsifier: The score was immaterial, fully inspectable, or routinely displaced by documented independent judicial reasoning.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when the score-to-sentence chain and score-blind counterfactual are both terminal.

lanes.title: Idaho Medicaid: compare opaque budget reduction with protected-service counterfactual
lanes.question: Did the judicially protected prior-budget path preserve services and force a more accurate, contestable replacement tool?
lanes.falsifier: The protected-service path failed, the old tool was accurate, or the replacement produced no material improvement in notice, accuracy, or outcome.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close with matched old-tool, preserved-benefit, and replacement-tool outcomes.

lanes.title: SyRI: test whether judicial prohibition survived system succession
lanes.question: Did the Article 8 judgment terminate the operative constitution or merely move equivalent functions into successor systems?
lanes.falsifier: SyRI was fully dismantled, data and models were removed, and successors used materially different transparent and contestable processes.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when prior projects, shutdown, alternatives, and successor systems are separately terminal.

lanes.title: Robodebt: reconcile debt inference, subject burden, public learning, and redress
lanes.question: Who authored the debt rules, who bore the error, what counterfactuals existed, and did later inquiry, reform, and compensation repair or merely metabolize the failure?
lanes.falsifier: The government bore uncertainty before action, errors were promptly corrected, harms were fully repaired, and no material learning or benefit followed subject-borne error.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when inference, harm, remedy, counterfactual, learning, and cost are reconciled across a representative denominator.

lanes.title: Evidentiary stratigraphy: sediment, bedrock, fault lines, and moving waterline
lanes.question: Which bounded propositions have compacted into durable evidence, which remain suspended, which constrain the map, and which vertical joins now define the shoreline?
lanes.falsifier: The stratigraphy merely recodes record counts, hides non-links, or promotes systems without vertical causal chains.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close each release only when every record has a reproducible stratum and every system has a source-bounded waterline state.
